title: How To Swing Dance For Beginners (East Coast Swing)

method.teacher_system: The teacher breaks down the East Coast Swing basic step from the back view, demonstrates it to music, and then adds turns and position changes with step-by-step guidance.
method.signature: Structuring the lesson as a clear numbered format of breakdowns followed immediately by music practice.

practices.what: Breakdown of the basic swing step starting from the back view.
Practicing the basic step to music from a face-to-face angle.
Breakdown of how to turn the basic step in place.
Practicing the turning basic step to music.
Breakdown of transitioning from closed hold to open position.
Practicing the open position transition to music.

beliefs.belief: Fundamental steps can be taught effectively to absolute beginners online through structured breakdowns.

moments.says: The teacher introduces themselves and explains they teach people how to ballroom and latin dance from home.
The teacher breaks down the basic step and tells leaders and followers where to start.
The teacher explains they will show how to turn the basic step on one spot.
The teacher directs the learner to visit their website for more swing dance lessons.
The teacher introduces a variation for getting into open position from closed position.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable of learning swing dance fundamentals from home step by step.

struggles.theme: Hard to remember all movements and keep up in a live class

clicked.theme: Very easy to follow, step-by-step instructions in slow motion

requests.theme: Wants more lessons for different dances or west coast swing

meant.theme: Brought back happy memories and inspired learning with a partner

method.limits: The video shows standard room lighting and does not feature close-ups of footwork specifically.
